title: Nothing you can see: Pullman's palm-house stairs read from two pictures
items: Nothing you can see changes yet. The 1894 Inland Architect plate and Taylor's photograph of Pullman's palm house had seemed to disagree about the stairs before it. Read together through their two cameras, they agree. The raised balustrade in the plate and the porch under the awning in the photograph are the same thing: the house's own raised porch toward 18th Street. The palm house's terrace and its flight of steps match both pictures as already built, so the porch is the next thing to build, as part of the house.
